learning_outcomes.text: Ability to use basic engineering knowledge necessary for solving chemical engineering problems.
Ability to solve chemical engineering problems individually.
Ability to analyze and interpret acquired data.
Ability to design a system, system component, and objectives.
Ability to identify and solve engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Unit systems / Introduction to mass balances; general equation, continuous systems, process balancing
Mass balance in multiple systems (Molecular and atomic balances), Recycle and purge systems
Chemical reaction stoichiometry (limiting reactant, excess reactant, fractional conversion, extent of reaction, multiple reactions, yield and selectivity)
Balances in reacting systems (Molecular and atomic balances, independent reactions, independent species, product separation, recycle and purge systems)
Combustion reactions (calculations on wet and dry basis, theoretical and excess air)
Single-phase systems (ideal gases, ideal gas mixtures)
Multi-phase systems (Single component, Gas-Liquid systems, Adsorption)
Multi-phase systems (Solid-Liquid solutions: solubility, saturation, crystallization, hydrated salts)
Equilibrium between two liquids (mutual solubility, phase diagrams, ternary phase systems, extraction)
Energy balances in reacting systems (Heat of reaction, Hess's Law, heat of formation, heat of combustion, energy and mass balances, fuels and combustion)
